new: A story can no longer move a headset's eyes. The fault of the exposome story (v212 to v225: the scene stuck to your head, the beams below your hands) came from one line in a story; the shell now keeps the eye cameras to itself, whatever a story does.
If a story leaves the picture drawing somewhere else after a frame, the shell puts it back on the headset and says so once in the console.
The package check refuses a story whose drawing code tries to move its camera. The pass story had the same line (harmless, on a page only): it is fixed.

The exposome story (Invisible threads) in VR and in AR: the scene stays put.
Sharp text, occlusion and the spaceships in a headset: each still looks right.
The pass story on a page: the globe and the cell are lit as before.
untested: The lock on the eye cameras was tried only with a pretend headset: that it changes nothing in the picture on a Quest is untested.
